item.title: Nova Cloud Launches Online IT Store with Automated MTN & Airtel MoMo in Uganda
item.description: Ugandans can now order Cloud VPS hosting, Tier III colocation rack space, QuickBooks Enterprise licenses, and WiFi hotspot access passes online with instant automated settlement in UGX via MTN Mobile Money (*165#) and Airtel Money (*185#).

item.title: Nova Cloud Edges Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Security Certification
item.description: Nova Cloud Edges (U) Limited has officially achieved ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management accreditation for its Kampala Tier III Datacenter facilities.

item.title: Expanding High-Speed Data Center Colocation Racks in Kampala
item.description: We have commissioned 20 additional 1U/2U server colocation racks connected directly to RENU, Liquid Telecom, and MTN Uganda fiber interconnects.
